concepts.title: Compact eligibility desk — recommended homepage entry
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, feasible NSEDU website Section 4 only, not a homepage/hero. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: keep its warm light ivory background #FFFAF8, primary wine #72243B, secondary taupe #806C60, greige #F1ECE8, text #2A2024, thin borders #E8D7DC, DM Serif Display section headings and Plus Jakarta Sans labels, body and controls. Make the next section visually connected to this compact editorial college explorer but an original eligibility interaction. Wide desktop flat front-facing UI screenshot, roughly 1600x720, all edges visible, tightly composed with moderate margins, small 8–12px corner radii, subtle shadows, simple outline icons, real readable text. NO device frame, no header/navigation/footer, no big hero photography, no blue, no neon, no glass effect, no gradients, no fake popularity statistics, no circular percentages, no 3D floating objects, no decorative clutter, no oversized empty cards. Results can only illustrate fictional data; never claim real eligibility or guaranteed admission. Every visible text should be spelled accurately and professionally. Tiny concept label in the bottom margin: 'NSEDU · Section 4 visual concept'. Important: content must be compact and readable, not inflated to fill canvas. Design the DEFAULT ENTRY state. Top heading 'Check your course eligibility', subtitle 'Understand the requirements before you apply.' Small top-right pill 'No sign-up to start'. Below, one finely bordered white panel uses a 65/35 split with a vertical rule. LEFT: small title 'Tell us about your studies' and a six-field grid, 3 columns x 2 rows, with clearly labeled form controls. EXACT field labels/values: 'Course' / 'B.Tech'; 'Qualification' / 'Class 12 passed'; 'Admission year' / '2026–27'; 'Subjects studied' / 'Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics'; 'PCM aggregate (%)' / 'Enter percentage'; 'Entrance exam' / 'Not taken yet'. Subject control a slightly longer searchable multi-select that wraps cleanly; a small muted note under marks 'Use the subjects required for your selected course.' Bottom left primary wine button 'Check eligibility' with right arrow; beside it a subtle underline link 'Not sure about your course?'. Under action tiny copy 'A basic check starts with your academics.' RIGHT: light greige inset without huge card, heading 'Your next step, made clear', three compact stacked rows with taupe line icons, each title and one short description: 'Requirements you meet' / 'See the academic criteria behind a match.'; 'What is still needed' / 'Know which details or exams to add.'; 'Colleges to explore' / 'Continue with programme-level requirements.' Beneath right content quiet line 'Save your check when you create an account.' At bottom of main panel a slim rule and compact note 'Eligibility and admission chances are separate. Final requirements depend on the institution and admission year.' Keep same calm professional density as the reference. No result statuses yet because the percentage field is empty.
